s.n: Tom, Dick and Harry sausage rolls
s.note: Three tunnels dug at once. Flaky pork sausage rolls.
s.how: Mix the mince, onion, carrot, breadcrumbs and sage with salt and pepper. Halve the pastry sheets, lay a log of filling along each and roll up, sealing with egg. Cut into short lengths, brush with egg and bake at 200C until puffed and golden. Serve hot with the brown sauce.

s.note: Ashley-Pitt's dirt in plain sight. Black bean dip, garlic toasts.
s.how: Blitz the beans with 1 garlic clove, the spices, 2 tbsp oil, lemon juice and a splash of water until smooth. Brush the bread with the rest of the oil and toast until golden. Rub the toasts with the other cut garlic clove. Spoon the dip into a bowl, scatter with parsley and serve with the toasts.

m.n: Escape committee beef and barley stew
m.note: Bartlett plans to break out 250 men. Slow beef and barley stew with herb dumplings.
m.how: Toss the beef in seasoned flour and brown it in batches in the oil. Add the onions and carrots, then the barley, stock and bay leaves, and simmer covered until tender. Rub the butter into the self-raising flour with the parsley and salt, then stir in enough cold water for a soft dough. Drop spoonfuls onto the stew, cover and simmer until the dumplings are puffed.

m.note: Hilts rides for the Swiss fence. Potato rosti with bratwurst.
m.how: Par-boil the whole potatoes for 10 minutes, cool, then grate coarsely and season. Melt half the butter in a pan, press in the potato and fry until a golden crust forms, then flip and crisp the other side with the rest of the butter. Fry the bratwurst and onion until browned. Cut the rosti into wedges and serve with the bratwurst, onion, sauerkraut and mustard.

w.note: Hilts's ball in the cooler. Vanilla between choc biscuits.
w.how: Beat the butter and sugar, then beat in the egg. Mix in the flour, cocoa and bicarb, roll into 16 balls and flatten on lined trays. Bake at 180C until just set, then cool completely. Sandwich a thick slice of ice cream between pairs of cookies and freeze until firm.

d.note: Bartlett calls it shattering. Ice-cold vodka and apple.
d.how: Fill 4 tin mugs with ice and pour 60ml vodka into each. Top with apple juice and a squeeze of lemon.
